spec: wiki Methods/'Method - Deep feedforward PC-ALM and belief-credit separation plan' (E2/E3), 2026-10-19
model: generative predictor of pred_gpc.py (residual top-down maps, widths 600 / 256 at depths 3 / 10), 4000 steps, batch 256, k in {1,2,3} seen views

stage1_belief.pc: plain-PC relaxation of the joint energy, hidden precision 1, T = 400, c = stage-1 selected PC c
stage1_belief.oracle: BP auto-decoder inference of s, T = 400, c = stage-1 selected BP c (backprop for inference only)
stage1_belief.amort: one pass of the amortiser, mean over seen views; trained locally toward s - eta_s * dL/ds with dL/ds from the SEEN views' stage-2 state; amortiser rule fixed to PC-ALM alpha 1 in both C0 and C1

rule_sep.stage2_credit: all 4 views, s fixed, hidden levels start at topdown(s) (zero hidden residuals), lam = 0; T2 primal steps (selected), dual step lam += r every k_in steps; penalty rho = hidden precision; activity step scale c = 1; no step-size retries
rule_sep.weights: gradient of the augmented energy at the final stage-2 state

selection.A1: per depth, oracle belief + PC-ALM, seed 0, 90/10 train split, full 4000 steps, c = 1, rho 16: k_in {1,5} x T2 {200, 800}
selection.A0: per depth, oracle belief + alpha 0, rho {1, 16} at A1's T2 (k_in irrelevant)
selection.rule: lowest held-out k=1 nmse among runs that neither diverge nor explode; a failed run is a result and is never retried. If all fail, the least-bad (last-finite) run is used, flagged selection_failed, and the job continues
selection.why_rho_16: float64 gate at fixed s: credit cosine rises with rho (C2: d10 0.83 at rho 1, 0.98 at 16); a linearised analysis (numerics review) finds rho nearly cancels in the stage-2 dynamics while T2 and k_in govern convergence and transient growth, so those are the selected knobs

reference: frozen BP auto-decoder G1 (3 seeds; d3 0.3053, d10 0.2783). No new BP arm (user decision: BP gets none of PC's modifications).

readings.metric: test k=1 nmse, clean, T = 400 for the belief stage; compared with frozen G1 seed 0 (shares init and batch stream); G1 3-seed sd reported beside every threshold
readings.credit_at_depth: A1 at d10 stable (finite, not exploded, res_rel not growing, at c = 1 without retry) and within 0.01 of G1 seed 0 => 'the multiplier loop at fixed oracle s gives working credit at depth'. A1 unstable or collapsed => 'the multipliers fail at depth even with the belief removed'. Stability of A1 is reported over all 4 selection configs, not only the winner.
readings.coupling: NOT claimed from A1 alone: A1 differs from C2 in belief source, frozen s, cold stage-2 start, T2 and k_in. B1 (local PC belief, decoupled) vs C2 is the coupling comparison, stated with those differences.
readings.belief_cost: B1 - A1 and C1 - A1 at their own test-time belief, plus the train-belief x test-belief table (every decoder evaluated under oracle and PC test-time beliefs)
readings.multipliers: A0 - A1, B0 - B1, C0 - C1 (alpha 0 controls have their own rho)
readings.classes: |delta| < 0.01 no detectable effect; 0.01-0.03 candidate (seeds 1, 2 later); > 0.03 or failure reportable at screen level; effects under 2 x G1 sd are 'unresolved'
readings.failures: diverged or exploded runs are results, reported with their last-finite score

scope: seed 0 screen; 'oracle' isolates credit and is not a local method; amortised arms have no T sweep (one pass)
